headline: Newberry win at last as Anderson are held
dek: Newberry, who had lost every match that carried a result, won at Bob Jones on Tuesday. Anderson were held to a draw at Emory & Henry, their second draw of an unbeaten season, and their fourteen goals now match Catawba's at the top of the chart.
displaced_by: Anderson drew at Emory & Henry and drew level with Catawba on fourteen goals, so Catawba no longer lead the chart alone; Newberry won their first match.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Anderson's fourteen goals have come from eight different scorers, and no one of them has more than Jonas Zethofer's three; they have conceded six.

wire.line: Newberry win at last, and Emory & Henry hold Anderson in the only match of theirs to carry a result.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every Emory & Henry match but Tuesday's, the latest of them at home to Palm Beach Atlantic.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry's win at Bob Jones was their first of the season; they have scored seven and conceded sixteen in one win and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba have scored fourteen and conceded three in four wins and a draw; Alex Payton has four of the goals from sixteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate have scored twelve and conceded four in three wins and two defeats, and followed a home defeat to Francis Marion with a win at Middle Georgia State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's Elijah Buford has made eighteen saves and conceded two goals.

last_match.line: Anderson remain unbeaten but have been held again; for Emory & Henry it is the only match of theirs to carry a result.

next_match.line: Lincoln Memorial have won their only conference match so far; Lenoir-Rhyne are still without a win of any kind.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
